notes: Year-only: the page states a year rule only (1st & 2nd numerical digits) and no month or week rule. The two page images are data-plate photographs, not decode charts, so there is no chart-only style. Page example serial used as the example; its expected year follows from the page's stated positions (85 -> 1985 under the century rule).

styles.era: Serials of the form 2 digits, 3 letters, 4 digits (dashes stripped by normalization)
styles.notes: Year = 1st & 2nd numerical digits [0,2] (1-based converted). Character and digit-only countings coincide here (leading characters are digits).
